An '''Imperial officer''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] serving at the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] installation known as the [[Krake Data Vault]] on [[Krake's Planet]]. The officer commanded the data vault's security center and was berating an underling for a dusty computer console when [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] used [[Mind trick/Legends#Force persuasion|Force persuasion]] to make her order the vault's energy shield turned off to allow Skywalker to rescue [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] with the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']]. Following the rescue, the officer came to her senses and had the shield reactivated, which trapped the ''Falcon'' inside. To escape the installation and its energy shield, Skywalker used the [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shields]] of the ''Falcon'' to cause an explosion of the vault power generators. Skywalker's actions resulted in a massive explosion that destroyed the vault, killing the female officer and everyone else inside.

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|There's dust on that console, mister! How many times have I told you--to&hellip;disengage&hellip;protective&hellip;energy&hellip;shield&hellip;immediately!|Unidentified Imperial officer|<ref name="Star Wars (1977) 63">[[Star Wars (1977) 63|''Star Wars'' (1977) 63]]</ref>}}
A Human female, the officer had short, curly black [[Hair/Legends|hair]], fair skin, and blue [[Eye/Legends|eyes]]. She appeared to be a strict and efficient commanding officer, and was susceptible to Luke Skywalker's [[Mind trick/Legends#Force persuasion|Force persuasion]] ability when he manipulated her from a distance.
